assertions.description: setMicrophoneActive() is a function on the media session.
setCameraActive() is a function on the media session.
setMicrophoneActive() returns a Promise (Chrome 158 / current spec), not undefined (as shipped in Chrome 93).
assertions.test: (() => { const r = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); if (r && typeof r.catch === 'function') r.catch(() => {}); return r instanceof Promise; })()

assertions.description: setCameraActive() returns a Promise (Chrome 158 / current spec), not undefined (as shipped in Chrome 93).
assertions.test: (() => { const r = navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(false); if (r && typeof r.catch === 'function') r.catch(() => {}); return r instanceof Promise; })()

assertions.description: In a fully active document the returned promise resolves with undefined, per the update capture state algorithm.
assertions.test: (async () => { const r = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); if (!(r instanceof Promise)) return false; return (await r) === undefined; })()

assertions.description: Called on a media session whose document is not fully active (removed iframe), the method returns a promise rejected with InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (async () => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.src = 'about:blank'; f.style.display = 'none'; f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); document.body.append(f); const s = f.contentWindow.navigator.mediaSession; if (!s || typeof s.setMicrophoneActive !== 'function') { f.remove(); return false; } const m = s.setMicrophoneActive.bind(s); f.remove(); let r; try { r = m(true); } catch { return false; } if (!(r instanceof Promise)) return false; try { await r; return false; } catch (e) { return e && e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } })()
